news.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest
news.summary: Supposed whitehat hackers behind Sunday’s Liquid Network breach have returned 3,400 of the 4,000 BTC they took, but nearly $47 million in bitcoin is still outstanding.

news.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%

news.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
news.summary: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

news.title: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
